options.content:
### Reading this dashboard

- **Approx. queued assignments** is `assigned - running`; GitHub does not publish a personal-account queue metric to ARC.
- **Tier** is a low-cardinality scrape label copied from each ARC listener pod.
- **Per-node pressure** comes from kube-state-metrics pod labels joined to pod placement. The current safe limit is 12 total / about 4 per node.
- ARC job counters reset when listener pods restart, so throughput panels use `rate()` or `increase()`.
- Runner workspaces and Docker graphs use pod-scoped generic ephemeral volumes on the separate `ci-zfs-ext4` NVMe class. A later burst peaked at 11 runners and exposed etcd/API pressure, so the ceiling remains 12 until another clean soak.
- Empty latency panels mean no jobs matched the current filters.

panels.description: A cache-neutral, manually dispatched comparison using the same repository and commands on ubuntu-24.04 and the home fleet.

options.content:
### Baseline captured 2026-08-16

| Signal | GitHub hosted | Home fleet | Result |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| End-to-end job | 43 s | 70 s | Hosted wins on cold startup |
| Setup | 1 s | 16 s | Cold ARC/PVC startup is the largest gap |
| Install dependencies | 8 s | 14 s | Package-cache target |
| Check + test + build | 25 s | 23 s | Home is ~8% faster |
| CPU proof | 1.312 s | 2.182 s | Hosted CPU is faster for this serial task |
| 512 MiB durable write | 1.161 s | 0.766 s | Home is ~1.5× faster |
| 512 MiB direct read | 1.302 s | 0.109 s | Home is ~12× faster |

[Open benchmark run 31968358817](https://github.com/DavidIlie/davidapps-telemetry/actions/runs/31968358817). This is a deliberate one-shot baseline; the live panels above track every home-fleet job.

panels.description: Driver-level receive-error ratio for the two physical 10 GbE members on each davidapps node. A minimum traffic guard hides isolated members that still report carrier. Node Exporter exposes aggregate receive errors rather than a dedicated CRC counter.

targets.expr: (100 * sum by(kubernetes_node,device) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{cluster="davidapps-cluster",device=~"eno1|eno2"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by(kubernetes_node,device) (rate(node_network_receive_packets_total{cluster="davidapps-cluster",device=~"eno1|eno2"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by(kubernetes_node,device) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{cluster="davidapps-cluster",device=~"eno1|eno2"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)) and on(kubernetes_node,device) sum by(kubernetes_node,device) (rate(node_network_receive_packets_total{cluster="davidapps-cluster",device=~"eno1|eno2"}[$__rate_interval])) > 1
